nom: Exuviance Pure Retinol Correcting Facial Peel

avis.texte: As an avid dennis gross lover this brand is new to me and i have no complaints. My skin has looked great. Ive used both variety packs and i love them. Ordering more now. Gives you the refresh you need. Love it!!

I have been struggling with acne for years! Just a bit of background, I do struggle with Seb Derm on my scalp and it occasionally travels to my ear, face, and neck area, which has contributed to my acne breakouts consistently especially around my face. I have tried everything, with the exception of going to a salon for chemical peels and all. I have experimented with all types of facial cleaners, serums, masks, all claiming to reduce/control acne, clear dark spots (yes, I developed massive scars from my acne), and reduce open pores. I finally found something that works, and I am in love! I have only used this product for 2 weeks and I can already see the difference on my face. My scaring has reduced and the spotting developed from healing acne is fading. I have had minimal breakouts since I started using this product. I did see another review prior to buying this item to cut the pads in half to yield more usage since there is extra fluids inside packaging. I have found that to be a useful tip. I am waiting patiently for the brand to have a sale to buy more items since they are quite on pricey side. You will get your money's worth though.

avis.titre: Closest to a chem peel at the esthetician
avis.texte: This stuff is very effective and strong, so I highly recommend for those of us with the opposite of sensitive skin. I usually leave it on for five minutes longer than the instructions say but I only do the peel once a week, if that. It will last a lot longer that way, which is great because these are not cheap. It does feel pretty spicy when you wipe it on. But after using just once my skin is super soft and smooth and it helps clear up my never-ending acne bubbling on my forehead. I sometimes have mild peeling afterwards but I would have peeling after a chemical peel done by a professional so I expect it. I'm not sure if it's helping with lines and wrinkles because I use several products in my routine, but it's part of my routine which has been keeping my face looking smooth and minimizing wrinkles.

avis.titre: So transformative! Finally my best skin ever!
avis.texte: I was nervous to try this as I am pretty sensitive but WOW this changed my skin even after just one use! The way this cleared up my dark spots and acne scars, and made my texture disappear. I'm an esthi so I knew I would be dry and peely for a few days but it was not bad at all. I had some redness and flakiness but I used the Exuviance Radiance Serum morning and night to heal it up and it works like a dream. I've been careful to not do too many other actives after doing the peel, and wearing lots of SPF!
I was a bit skeptical before I tried it the first time but I absolutely love this product and actually use it twice a week. The day after I use it, my face feels lifted and a bit tightened.

avis.titre: Good product to add to your skincare routine
avis.texte: I was able to try the Exuviance Pure Retinol Correcting Facial Peel recently, thanks to Influenster, for my honest opinion. I used this every Sunday for 4 weeks. I did have the peeling effect a few days after applying but that is what I expected . It felt almost the same as getting a facial peel at the spa. It does have an alcohol type smell to it but I personally didn't mind it. After week 1, I didn't notice a huge change other than maybe a little softer skin. Week 2: Softer skin and a little less dullness. Week 3: Softer skin, less dullness, pores looked slightly smaller and dark spots a little lighter. Week 4: Same results as week 3, slightly improved. Overall, if you are going to use this product long term, I really think it helps the appearance and texture of your skin. However, if you are looking for a quick fix product then it may not be for you.

I love loved this!! I used it with the serum and i felt like i noticed a difference in my skin. Its so smooth and brighter! I will probably be buying more. But im so glad that the package comes with 6 peels and you use 1 every week so thats amazing!!

avis.titre: Exuviance Pure Retinol Correcting Facial Peel is a must-h...

It just takes a simple tear of the packet and you will immediately be overwhelmed by the scent of alcohol that disappears right after you apply it to your skin. I'm excited to see what the next 3 weeks will do.
Super easy to use. Comes in a 6 week peel pads. I noticed since using my dark.spots an.pores were less noticeable. You use this once a week all.over face an rinse off in am love this

I've been nervous about using pills simply because I'm rather new to them, I've used one before briefly on a different brand and didn't use it as directed because I was scared. This, however, I decided to take the plunge and leave it on all night like directed. And it worked amazing! My skin looks lighter and brighter after just one use. It says you will start to notice a big difference after 4 to 6 weeks (4-6 uses). So I can only imagine how much better my skin is going to look by the time I'm done with the regimen. You use one a week, and it comes in such a handy form that it's really simple to apply. It comes in a pre-wet pad package. The other one I had tried was a Cream, that they said to apply with the pad. This packaging is brilliant. The pad is already wet with the product and ready to use. That's probably one of my favorite parts of it. Just smart. It tingled just slightly around my chin area, I avoided my nose area because that tends to be more sensitive. It tangled for maybe 10 minutes and then went away. I cleanse my face applied this peel and then. Put on a good moisturizer on top. I slept overnight and then this morning I rinsed it off and resumed my regular skin care routine. I'm excited to continue to use these once a week and from the looks of it, I'll be repurchasing more.
